results.title: Exhibition: Taixu in Singapore: A 100-Year Commemoration
results.description:
Taixu (1890–1947) was one of the most influential Chinese Buddhist monks of the 20th century, best known for his efforts to modernise Buddhism and make it relevant to a rapidly changing world.

Commemorating the centenary of Taixu’s first visit to Singapore in 1926, the exhibition Taixu in Singapore: A 100-Year Commemoration brings renewed attention to his enduring influence on the development of Buddhism in Singapore and the wider region.

results.title: Discover Digital 2026 (#dd26)
results.description:
Discover Digital is back — and bigger than ever!

Bigger adventures, better prizes, and the whole crew behind NUS Libraries' digital resources; all in one day. Join Libbie, pick up a hat or two along the way, and rack up points for your chance to win. Every friend of Libbie's deserves a good adventure.

Visit booths set up by our librarians and resource partners, take on quick tasks, and rack up points* as you go. Some are worth more than others. So the more you tackle, the better your odds when prizes are drawn. Easy paw-sy, right? (Don't quote Libbie on that…)

You are only required to register to participate in the games. Separate registration is not required to attend individual workshops.

*No points will be awarded for attending workshops.

More information on the event: https://nus.edu.sg/nuslibraries/discover-digital-2026/highlights
results.more_info:
Register for the Discover Digital 2026 game here. More instructions on PlayTours will be sent on 19 August 2026, 9am. Please check your emails to play the game!

Only current full-time NUS students and staff (excluding staff from NUS Libraries) are eligible to participate in the game.

Some things to note:

  • You'll need a device with Internet/Wi-Fi access and a camera (mobile phone/tablet) as we'll be giving you a link on PlayTours (web-based app) to access the game with some tasks requiring the scanning of QR codes on your device. 
  • Register individually to play the game and be eligible for the goodie bag, prizes and lucky draw (You can play together with your friends BUT you must register individually if you want to qualify for prizes).
  • Do NOT use the Incognito/Private mode of your browsers when using PlayTours as they will be unable to save your game progress. Once a Private/Incognito PlayTours window is closed, you will have to retrieve the link to your session of the game through your email.
  • There is a variety of tasks to complete during Discover Digital 2026 to earn points. Choose the ones that pique your interest and accumulate the minimum number of points. 
  • All activities will be held at NUS Central Library. Refer to the Discover Digital 2026 floorplan to help navigate where the booths and workshops are located: https://nus.edu.sg/nuslibraries/discover-digital-2026/highlights  
  • Please refer to the game rules and terms and conditions for the goodie bag, prizes and lucky draw eligibility: https://nus.edu.sg/nuslibraries/discover-digital-2026/gameplay
